essence: Therefore none other than those purifying persons should be worshipped.
Therefore even such worshippers become worthy of worship on earth.
Therefore even an outcaste, having taken refuge and become purified, may attain the Kaula state.
Therefore all dharmas are immersed in Kula dharma.
Therefore these practitioners purify even their mleccha, śvapaca, and lowly associates.
